title: Client arrives late
summary: A client arrives later than their scheduled appointment time. How should you handle it professionally?

steps.title: Greet warmly
steps.body: Welcome the client with a calm and friendly attitude.

steps.title: Check availability
steps.body: Confirm the time available for their service.

steps.title: Communicate clearly
steps.body: Let the client know how the delay may impact their service.

steps.title: Offer options
steps.body: Suggest rescheduling, a shorter service, or alternative times.

steps.title: Thank and reassure
steps.body: Thank the client for understanding and ensure they feel valued.

remember: Empathy and clear communication build trust and great experiences.
